descriptions.zh: 分配一艘科研船前往[Root.GetStarName]星系去解码黑洞中传来的神秘信号。
descriptions.en: Dedicate a science vessel to deciphering the unlikely signal from the black hole in the [Root.GetStarName] system.

descriptions.zh: 设立一个研究项目来进一步研究环形神殿——它的起源，它的目的。
descriptions.en: Establish a research project to learn more about the Loop Temple, its origins, and its purpose.

titles.zh: 研究信使，以及其传递的讯息
titles.en: Study the Messenger, and its message

descriptions.zh: 或许我们可以将信使和其他事件之间建立联系——或许我们甚至还可以找到一个合理的解释。
descriptions.en: Perhaps we can establish a connection to certain other events - perhaps even find an explanation.

descriptions.zh: 初步发现表明，信使是一种更加高阶的智慧形态，尽管肉体上更加脆弱。
descriptions.en: Initial findings suggest that it was a more intelligent although, perhaps, feebler form.

descriptions.zh: 初步发现表明，信使是一种远比我们更加强健，并且可能，更具侵略性的生命形态。
descriptions.en: Initial findings suggest that it was a much more rugged and, perhaps, more aggressive form.

descriptions.zh: 干涉，破坏，传播误导信息。必须在限度之内采用一切手段。
descriptions.en: Interference, sabotage, disinformation. We'll do as much as we can without crossing the line.

descriptions.zh: 采用伪造、绑架、教化、甚至纵火和谋杀等秘密行动阻止邪教：我们必须迅速采取行动。
descriptions.en: Covert operations including forgery, kidnapping, indoctrination, even arson and murder: we do what we must.

descriptions.zh: 派遣人种学者到星球表面近距离观摩神之圆环的仪式。这是一个令人瞩目的文化事件！我们必须尽可能多地进行研究。
descriptions.en: Send ethnographers to the surface to watch the Coils rituals up close. This is a remarkable cultural event! We must learn as much as we can.

titles.en: Investigate the disappearance of the population

descriptions.zh: 之前人口多的挤不下，现在人们一夜之间蒸发了。究竟发生了啥？
descriptions.en: There were too many colonists, and now there are none at all. What happened?

titles.zh: 调查……查清楚这些人发生了啥
titles.en: Investigate the... whatever happened to the population

descriptions.zh: 之前人口多的挤不下，然而现在的人口似乎全部被替换过。究竟发生了啥？
descriptions.en: There were too many colonists, and now there seems to be a completely different population. What happened?

titles.zh: 净化所有疑似的外星人复制体
titles.en: Purge the population of presumed alien duplicates

descriptions.zh: 唯一处理[Root.GetName]上发生的神秘人口替换事件就是用轨道轰炸把整个星球夷平。
descriptions.en: The only way to deal with the mysterious population replacement on [Root.GetName] is to enact an orbital bombardment regime which will purge them all.

descriptions.zh: 欧米伽理论得出的结论表明，我们之前遇到的时间奇点，正是这一切我们称为“圆环”，或者说是“时之螶”的事件的起因。在那里，悖论相互交织成结并最终凝结成一个意识体，一个处于时间之外的欲望与意志的联结。它的起因，或它的结局——很难用这样的词语来描述它，但它却被开始与终结深深吸引。我们可以使用欧米伽同调装置将它召唤到我们的母星系。如果我们这么做了，几乎肯定会有某些意料之外的事情将要发生。这样做意味着很多事情，但我们必须这么做，这是科学的探索。
descriptions.en: The Theory suggests that the temporal anomalies we have encountered are the cause of the thing we call the Loop, or the Worm. It's a tangled knot of paradoxes that has become conscious; a nexus of awareness and desire outside time. Its cause, or its result - it's hard to say with something like this. But it is attracted to endings and to beginnings. We can use the Omega Alignment to bring it through to our home system. If we do, something will certainly happen. This is many things, but especially, it is science.

titles.zh: 调查视界信号原点的碎片
titles.en: Investigate fragments at Horizon Signal origin

descriptions.zh: 当舰船引擎被引爆之后，它在舰船周围的时空产生了一连串涟漪。舰船的残骸展示出了独特的时空特性。
descriptions.en: When the drive detonated, it interrupted the changes in space around the ship. The fragments exhibit unusual physical and temporal properties.

descriptions.zh: “朔望”号曾存在于另一个时空。另一个可能的未来？亦或是另一个崭新的宇宙？我们可以从中学习到宝贵的智慧。
descriptions.en: The "Syzygy" had spent time in another place. A possible future? An alternate universe? We can learn more.
